name: Ethics and Responsibility II
description: Humans and Non Human Animals - the title of the seminar already expresses how complex the human-animal relationship is perceived, within our societies. The different disciplines offer different concepts to “change/improve” these relationships for the future. What world do we want to live in together? What is the difference between the mammal “human” and the “great ape”? In addition to the “classic” biological dividing lines, there are sociological and philosophical similarities that we discuss with the support of various texts.
prerequisites: Students should have basic knowledge in the field of Applied Ethics.
